loss_signature: logprob, advantage, valid, before, after, probe_valid, executed_cost, *, cost_weight

logprob.producer: partition_controller(mode=sample) return[1]; hard argmax is not a policy sample

advantage.producer: SupervisionBatch.advantage; loss-only, detached or discrete target

before.producer: same probes before handoff, detached target

after.producer: stage public probe readout after migrate_handoff_state

probe_valid.producer: stage explicit boolean probe_valid from typed applicability and supervision availability

executed_cost.producer: actual selected graph cost diagnostic, never soft cost relabeled as hard

loss_specs.name: handoff_behavior
loss_specs.numerator: sum of valid per-probe mean coordinate errors

stage_parameter_rule: Bindings beginning stage. are constructed by the L-stage, not implicit model parameters. Each actual Parameter must be uniquely assigned to exactly one owner, including shared aliases. Unlisted base parameters stay frozen.
input_contract: RoleBatch projections only. Finite floating tensors including padding; exact mask shapes, valid class indices, and explicit typed applicability are required. Supervision is passed only to losses.
loss_selection: Select named LossSpec terms, never total plus its components. Non-LossSpec return fields are diagnostics. External task_loss inputs are already masked/normalized with differentiable empty zero by the L-stage.
gradient_contract: Freeze base parameters with requires_grad=False, not no_grad around receiver computation. Teacher targets only may be detached. A discrete sampled decision uses its live selected log probability; deterministic argmax does not impersonate a policy gradient.
tokenizer_contract: No cross-tokenizer direct logit KL. Shared token-mixture losses require identical declared vocabulary; heterogeneous receivers use named common behavior coordinates.
execution: All adapters and losses gate before tensor backend import. No neural test, model import, initialization, optimization or efficacy claim in this task.
